# Consilyn

> Consilyn is a live answer screen for experts who take paid consultations. It runs in Chrome or Edge on Windows and Mac, or as a Windows app. During a call the client has agreed to, it transcribes both sides on the expert's laptop (audio is never saved or sent) and shows short answers to read aloud, built from the expert's own screening answers and background. Every answer is labelled with its source, and AI-written text is marked not verified.

Consilyn is a product of Amaltas Labs (https://www.amaltaslabs.com/). Website: https://consilyn.com/. Contact: hello@consilyn.com.

Key facts:

- Platform: in the browser, Chrome or Edge on Windows 10 and 11, and Chrome 141 or newer on macOS 14.2 or newer, at https://consilyn.com/app (nothing to install). Or the Windows app: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. 8 GB of memory. English only.
- Price: free during early access. After that, the first 5 calls are free, then 2 free calls a month; Consilyn Pro, with unlimited calls, is $39 a month, tax included. Payments by Dodo Payments, merchant of record: in the buyer's own currency (with Dodo's 4% conversion fee) or in US dollars, and in India by UPI or an Indian card.
- Where text goes: suggestions are written by Google Gemini with the user's own key. On Gemini's free tier, Google may use that text to improve its products and people may review it.
- The free-call counter receives only a scrambled laptop ID, a scrambled client-entry ID, the app version, call start and end times, the licence key, and, for a user who signs in with an email and a one-time code, that email and the device's sign-in token; never anything said. Free calls and Consilyn Pro follow the email to every device signed in with it.
- Before it listens, the app asks the expert to confirm the client knows the call is transcribed on the laptop and its text sent to Google's AI.
- Works best with Zoom and Google Meet in Chrome. Speeds were measured with a paid Gemini key; on the free tier answers can be slow or missing.
- Start: https://consilyn.com/app in the browser, or the free Windows installer at https://consilyn.com/#download (no account, no admin rights).

## Guides

- [AI assistants for expert calls: Cluely, Otter and others compared](https://consilyn.com/guides/ai-call-assistants-for-expert-calls/): Cluely, Final Round AI, Otter, Fireflies and Granola on a paid expert call: what each does during the call, what it answers from, and what network rules say.
- [How to answer expert network screening questions](https://consilyn.com/guides/answer-expert-network-screening-questions/): How to answer expert network screening questions: a simple structure, before-and-after examples, and how to stay accurate, consistent and confidential.
- [How expert network pay works: rates, minutes and payment terms](https://consilyn.com/guides/how-expert-network-pay-works/): How GLG, Guidepoint, AlphaSights, Third Bridge and Tegus pay experts: who sets the rate, which minutes count, what is unpaid, and when the money arrives.
- [How to prepare for an expert network call](https://consilyn.com/guides/prepare-for-an-expert-network-call/): What a paid expert consultation looks like, the questions clients ask, what you must never share, and a short checklist for the minutes before the call.
- [Screening questions that ask for free consulting: what to give](https://consilyn.com/guides/screening-questions-that-ask-for-free-consulting/): When an expert network screening question asks for the analysis itself: how to show you can answer it without giving the paid call away, with examples.
- [Can you use AI on an expert network call? What the rules say](https://consilyn.com/guides/using-ai-on-expert-calls/): Using AI before or during a paid expert call: what network terms say, how recording consent works, what confidentiality means, and a short checklist.
